title: Review and approve from your phone
description: The Desktop CNC Mill's requirements on a phone: a requirement with its trace, sent for review, and approved from the review queue.

steps.say: OpenV works on a phone. This is the Desktop CNC Mill's requirements list, with each artifact's reference, status and trace.
Tap a requirement to read it in full, with its quality score and the requirements in other projects that refine it.
Its trace and its verification follow below, the same as on a computer.
When it is ready, send it for review. The reviewers are notified on their own phones.
The review queue lists everything waiting: requirements in review, links flagged as suspect, and changes since the last baseline.
Approve it with a thumb. The approval goes into the requirement's history with your name and the time.
Install OpenV from the browser to your home screen, and notifications arrive as pushes.
